global: This is spicy ramen with a rich, deep-red broth. Topped with shredded bean sprouts and a whole boiled egg, it sits in a white bowl with red trim, under bright, even lighting on a clean white surface.

regions.background: The table surface appears smooth, light-colored, and slightly reflective with subtle shadows and faint texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red stripes, smooth surface, slightly curved rim, and subtle brownish residue along inner edge.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is deep red, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and topped with white bean sprouts.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and faint water droplets on its rounded tip.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth surface, oval shape, slightly translucent, resting in rich red broth.
